name: Band Alternating Curl
steps: Stand tall on the center of a resistance band with your feet hip-width apart and hold an end in each hand, palms facing forward.
Pin both elbows close to your sides and brace your core.
Curl one hand smoothly toward your shoulder by bending only at the elbow while the other arm stays extended.
Lower that hand slowly under tension, then curl the opposite arm, alternating sides on each repetition.
tips: Keep your elbows tucked beneath your shoulders without letting them drift forward.
Avoid swaying your torso back to overcome peak tension at the top of the band.
